newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lusomundo preference adjust to ord shares.
newsitem.headline: Lusomundo preference adjust to ord shares.

text.p: Preference share prices of Portuguese leisure group Lusomundo-SGPS are adjusting upwards to the level of its ordinary shares, after an excessive discount to the preference shares, a director said.
"There was an exaggerated discount in the preference shares in relation to the ordinary shares, and now an adjustment is taking place," Franquelim Alves told Reuters.
Dealers said 168,600 Lusomundo preference shares traded to stand at 1,400 escudos, up 46, at 1215 GMT. They said 4,900 ordinary Lusomundo shares traded at 1,880 escudos, up 60, at 1222 GMT.
Lusomundo shares were among the most active on Lisbon bourse today.
